newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH BREWER CONFIRMS BASS STAKE INCREASE.
newsitem.headline: CZECH BREWER CONFIRMS BASS STAKE INCREASE.

text.p: Pivovar Radgest a.s. on Tuesday confirmed reports that Britain's Bass Plc had raised its stake in the Czech brewer by about 10 percent to 30.7 percent.

Radegest Director Jan Sikora told Reuters that Bass had increased its stake but would not confirm a report by the CTK news agency that the British firm had bought the 10 percent stake from Raiffeisen Capital and Investment Praha.
Sikora would not comment further on the sale. Officials from both Bass and Raiffeisen said they could not immediately comment on the subject.

Bass, which holds a majority stake in major Czech brewer Prazske Pivovary , as well as smaller stakes in two other regional brewers as well as Radegast has said it hopes to strengthen its foothold in the country's brewing industry.

Bass has said that it was actively seeking to buy shares in Radegast, and had held talks with other major shareholders in Radegast -- bank IPB a.s. which has 34 percent and KIS a.s. which has around 30 percent - about increasing its stake.
